engagement.magnitude_basis: organoid FIS rescue vs sweat chloride fall
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading: the abstract says 'CFTR-restoring compounds'; that these include VX-809 is from the full text, not verified here. Patient side is Clancy 2012 (epub 2011), already in the tile.
engagement.note: Lumacaftor restored F508del CFTR swelling in patient organoids, two years after it had lowered sweat chloride in patients.
engagement.quote: Function of the CFTR F508del mutant protein is restored by incubation at low temperature, as well as by CFTR-restoring compounds.
engagement.judgement: Retrodiction: the organoid assay was first run in 2013, after lumacaftor's sweat-chloride result was public (Clancy 2011 epub), so 'retro', not 'same'.

engagement.magnitude_basis: per-patient organoid FIS vs per-patient sweat chloride change
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract only (Cell Rep full text returned 403; not in PMC). The split of the cohort between ivacaftor (not a member) and lumacaftor/ivacaftor, and whether the correlation holds within the lumacaftor arm, is not verified.
engagement.population: Mixed CFTR genotypes treated with ivacaftor or lumacaftor/ivacaftor
engagement.note: Per-patient organoid swelling correlated with each patient's sweat-chloride change on modulators.
engagement.short: Organoid response tracks individual sweat chloride
engagement.quote: The in vitro organoid responses correlated with both change in pulmonary response and change in sweat chloride concentration.
engagement.judgement: Kept as patient-level. It rests partly on ivacaftor monotherapy, which is not a member; if the lumacaftor/ivacaftor subset alone does not correlate, this entry should be dropped. retrodiction left null: whether organoids were measured before treatment outcomes were known is not stated in the abstract.

efficacy.note: Organoid forskolin swelling assay published; F508del rescue by CFTR-restoring compounds shown before lumacaftor's Phase 3 FEV1 result.
efficacy.quote: Function of the CFTR F508del mutant protein is restored by incubation at low temperature, as well as by CFTR-restoring compounds.

efficacy.confidence_note: Pairing. Dekkers 2013 did not state an expected clinical effect size, so this is direction only. Organoids were not the system the sponsor relied on.
efficacy.note: Organoids predicted lumacaftor rescue of F508del; TRAFFIC/TRANSPORT met FEV1, with a modest 2.6–4.0 point gain.
efficacy.quote: the difference between active treatment and placebo with respect to the mean absolute improvement in the percentage of predicted FEV1 ranged from 2.6 to 4.0 percentage points (P<0.001)
efficacy.judgement: Judgement call: scored as a pairing because the organoid lumacaftor data (2013) preceded the Phase 3 readout (2014 topline, 2015 paper), so it is not a retrodiction for FEV1.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: mean organoid FIS per genotype vs published trial outcome
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract-level reading. The correlation pools lumacaftor/ivacaftor and ivacaftor genotype groups.
efficacy.population: Genotype groups incl. F508del/F508del (lumacaftor/ivacaftor) and gating/residual-function (ivacaftor)
efficacy.drug_basis: lumacaftor/ivacaftor (VX-809/VX-770); ivacaftor alone also in the correlation
efficacy.note: Organoid responses by genotype correlated with published trial outcomes for lumacaftor and ivacaftor; one F508del/R347P subject responded little in vitro and in vivo.
efficacy.quote: In vitro drug responses in rectal organoids positively correlated with published outcome data from clinical trials with VX-809 and VX-770
efficacy.judgement: Retrodiction: compared against trial results already published. Patient-level because it ranks genotypes, not whether the class works.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: per-patient organoid FIS vs per-patient ppFEV1 change
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract only. Not a randomised trial: FEV1 changes are observational on-label responses, not a trial primary endpoint. Lumacaftor share of the cohort not verified.
efficacy.population: Mixed CFTR genotypes treated with ivacaftor or lumacaftor/ivacaftor
efficacy.note: Per-patient organoid swelling correlated with each patient's FEV1 change; ROC accuracy good to excellent.
efficacy.quote: The in vitro organoid responses correlated with both change in pulmonary response and change in sweat chloride concentration.
efficacy.judgement: Same caveats as the engagement entry. Kept because it is the stated individual-level comparison the HIT-CF programme was built on.

added_models.model: Fischer rat thyroid cells expressing CFTR variants (Ussing chamber)
added_models.model_kind_note: In vitro: a rat thyroid cell line transfected with human CFTR variants, not patient tissue.

engagement.confidence_note: Year 2015 is a proxy: Study 107 (F508del/minimal function) started in 2015 on this selection rule; the review was public in 2018.
engagement.model: Fischer rat thyroid cells expressing CFTR variants (Ussing chamber)
engagement.model_kind_note: In vitro: a rat thyroid cell line transfected with human CFTR variants, not patient tissue.
engagement.population: Non-F508del CFTR variants responsive in FRT
engagement.note: FRT chloride transport <10% of wild type defined 'non-responsive' mutations for tezacaftor Study 107.
engagement.quote: in vitro testing (mutations that responded with chloride transport < 10% of wild-type CFTR in the FRT cell Ussing Chamber assay)

engagement.magnitude_basis: FRT ≥10% of normal vs sweat chloride change
engagement.confidence_note: Year is the registry results posting (2024-08-01); the paper stating the FRT-to-trial translation is 2026. Abstract-level reading.
engagement.model: Fischer rat thyroid cells expressing CFTR variants (Ussing chamber)
engagement.model_kind_note: In vitro: a rat thyroid cell line transfected with human CFTR variants, not patient tissue.
engagement.population: 18 rare non-F508del variants FRT-responsive to ETI (no F508del)
engagement.note: In Study 445-124 (NCT05274269), patients with FRT-responsive rare variants cut sweat chloride by 28 mmol/L versus placebo.
engagement.quote: secondary endpoints of sweat chloride (-28.3 mmol/L [95% CI: -32.1, -24.5 mmol/L; P < .0001])
engagement.judgement: Prospective: participants were enrolled because FRT called their variant responsive (CT.gov). Population is outside the tile's F508del population.

efficacy.confidence_note: Year 2015 is the Study 107 start, a proxy for first use with a member.
efficacy.model: Fischer rat thyroid cells expressing CFTR variants (Ussing chamber)
efficacy.model_kind_note: In vitro: a rat thyroid cell line transfected with human CFTR variants, not patient tissue.
efficacy.note: Before Phase 3, FRT response ≥10% of normal was the rule for which genotypes tezacaftor/ivacaftor should help.
efficacy.quote: in vitro testing (mutations that responded with chloride transport < 10% of wild-type CFTR in the FRT cell Ussing Chamber assay)

efficacy.magnitude_basis: FRT net Cl transport vs 10% threshold vs ppFEV1
efficacy.confidence_note: The modified TEZ/IVA FRT assay was submitted with the NDA after EVOLVE/EXPAND read out; the reviewer checked it against those results.
efficacy.model: Fischer rat thyroid cells expressing CFTR variants (Ussing chamber)
efficacy.model_kind_note: In vitro: a rat thyroid cell line transfected with human CFTR variants, not patient tissue.
efficacy.drug_basis: tezacaftor (TEZ/IVA vs IVA alone in F508del)
efficacy.note: For F508del, ivacaftor alone stayed under the FRT 10% bar and tezacaftor/ivacaftor just cleared it, matching modest FEV1 benefit.
efficacy.quote: for the 508del mutation (for which IVA alone does not provide clinical benefit), the in vitro results for IVA did not meet the 10% threshold while they just met the 10% threshold for the TEZ/IVA combination
efficacy.judgement: Retrodiction: FDA describes checking 'consistency of in vitro assay findings with clinical efficacy data' already in hand. The review also says the assay does not predict whether tezacaftor adds benefit over ivacaftor.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: FRT ≥10% threshold vs ppFEV1 by mutation group
efficacy.confidence_note: Full text of the bundled review (sources/210491). FDA: the assay 'does not predict whether the addition of TEZ to IVA (Symdeko) will result in additional clinical benefit'.
efficacy.model: Fischer rat thyroid cells expressing CFTR variants (Ussing chamber)
efficacy.model_kind_note: In vitro: a rat thyroid cell line transfected with human CFTR variants, not patient tissue.
efficacy.population: F508del heterozygotes with residual-function or minimal-function second alleles
efficacy.note: Mutation groups above the FRT 10% bar responded; groups below it, including Study 107's F508del/minimal function, did not. Symdeko labelled in-vitro-only mutations.
efficacy.quote: for mutation groups for which there are positive clinical data, the TEZ/IVA combination in vitro result met or exceeded the 10% threshold and those that did not meet the 10% threshold failed to demonstrate clinical efficacy
efficacy.judgement: Patient-level same, called 'partial' because the residual-function responders are also ivacaftor-responsive, so that half rests on the potentiator; the Study 107 negative rests on the tezacaftor combination. regulatory_reliance true: the 2018 Symdeko label extends to mutations 'based on in vitro data'.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: binary FRT ≥10% call; magnitude not correlated
efficacy.confidence_note: No CDER review document for S-002 is posted (nda/2020 and nda/2021 paths 404); label and approval letter read in full. Approval date Dec 2020 from the letter's timetable reference and news reports.
efficacy.model: Fischer rat thyroid cells expressing CFTR variants (Ussing chamber)
efficacy.model_kind_note: In vitro: a rat thyroid cell line transfected with human CFTR variants, not patient tissue.
efficacy.population: 177 non-F508del CFTR variants FRT-responsive to ETI
efficacy.note: FDA extended Trikafta to 177 more variants on FRT data alone (sNDA 212273/S-002, Dec 2020); the label says the 10% call predicts benefit but not its size.
efficacy.short: Trikafta label extended on FRT alone
efficacy.quote: For individual mutations, the magnitude of the net change over baseline in CFTR-mediated chloride transport in vitro is not correlated with the magnitude of clinical response.
efficacy.judgement: Not a new status: the cell is already 'same' from 2018. Recorded for regulatory_reliance and because it is the regulator's own statement about elexacaftor. 'partial' because only the threshold, not the magnitude, predicts.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: FRT ≥10% call vs ppFEV1 vs placebo
efficacy.confidence_note: Registry NCT05274269 results posted 2024-08-01 show LS mean difference 9.2 (7.2, 11.3), p<0.0001, matching the paper.
efficacy.model: Fischer rat thyroid cells expressing CFTR variants (Ussing chamber)
efficacy.model_kind_note: In vitro: a rat thyroid cell line transfected with human CFTR variants, not patient tissue.
efficacy.population: 18 rare non-F508del variants FRT-responsive to ETI (no F508del)
efficacy.note: Study 445-124 enrolled only FRT-responsive non-F508del genotypes; ppFEV1 rose 9.2 points over placebo at 24 weeks.
efficacy.quote: In 445-124, mean improvements were seen in the primary endpoint of percent predicted FEV1 (9.2 percentage points [95% CI: 7.2, 11.3; P < .0001])

patient_trials.quote: In FRT cells, 518 of 620 (84%) rare variants responded to elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor.

efficacy.judgement: The first prospective randomised test of FRT-only genotype selection: the trial ran after the 2020 label relied on FRT. Population lies outside the tile's F508del population.

added_models.model: Patient nasal epithelial cell cultures (Ussing chamber)

efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract and PMC full text (PMC5547155) read. 2017 is first use with a member for patient-level prediction.
efficacy.note: Short-circuit current in each patient's own nasal cell cultures, with lumacaftor or tezacaftor added, as a readout of that patient's correctable CFTR.
efficacy.short: Nasal cells measure each patient's rescue
efficacy.quote: The CFTR correctors lumacaftor and tezacaftor significantly increased the ∆IscF/I+V response to about 25% (SEM = 4.4) of the WT-CFTR level and the CFTR apical expression to about 22% (SEM = 4.6) of the WT-CFTR level in F508del/F508del HNE cells.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: per-patient HNE corrected Isc vs per-patient FEV1 change at 6 months (R2 = 0.95)
efficacy.confidence_note: n = 8 (7 on lumacaftor/ivacaftor, 1 on ivacaftor, not a member). Full text says nasal cells were sampled before treatment started; whether the assay was read before the 6-month FEV1 was known is not stated. Not a registered trial.
efficacy.note: Lumacaftor/ivacaftor correction in each patient's pre-treatment nasal cells tracked that patient's FEV1 change after 6 months of Orkambi; three FEV1 non-responders had low in-vitro correction.
efficacy.short: Nasal-cell rescue ranks individual FEV1 response
efficacy.quote: The level of CFTR correction in HNE cultures significantly correlated with the FEV1 change at 6 months in 8 patients treated with CFTR modulators.
efficacy.judgement: Patient-level: cells were sampled before each patient started Orkambi, so this is scored as a prediction, not a retrodiction; the class result was already known in 2015 but the individual responses were not.

efficacy.magnitude_basis: HBE chloride transport vs ppFEV1 change
efficacy.confidence_note: Abstract only read. Phase 2, 29-day FEV1; Vertex took elexacaftor, not bamocaftor, to approval.
efficacy.note: VX-659 triple raised ppFEV1 up to 13.3 points (F508del/MF) and 9.7 points added to tezacaftor/ivacaftor (F508del/F508del), as its HBE activity predicted.
efficacy.short: Bamocaftor: FEV1 up to +13.3 as HBE predicted
efficacy.quote: Robust in vitro activity of VX-659-tezacaftor-ivacaftor targeting Phe508del CFTR protein translated into improvements for patients with Phe508del-MF or Phe508del-Phe508del genotypes.
efficacy.strengthens: First stated same-drug comparison on this track: efficacy 2 is a pairing the FDA called 'limited'; Davies 2018 states bamocaftor's HBE activity 'translated' into FEV1 gains.

gaps.lead: Elexacaftor tox (NDA 212273): rat/dog no liver signal vs Trikafta transaminases/liver failure
gaps.detail: No elexacaftor tox track exists in the draft, so no entry can be appended; under the decision-12 (#70) adjudication already applied to safety 2 (label attributes liver injury to the TRIKAFTA combination, not a class drug), a new track would score only untested. Changes nothing scored.

Safety 1 (lumacaftor-rat-dog-tox) is already untested/unsettled; the Orkambi 2015 label 5.2 liver SAEs (3 vs 0) are attributed to the ORKAMBI combination with an ivacaftor backbone and transaminase rates matched placebo, so under the decision-12 adjudication a 2015 entry stays untested. Note only; changes nothing scored.
